newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end higher, Banco Santiago sinks.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end higher, Banco Santiago sinks.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed firmer on Tuesday even though Banco Santiago tumbled for the second straight day after news of a lower-than-expected price for its stock offering, dealers said.
The market is seen opening steady with turnover continuing light, they said.
The 40-share IPSA index closed 0.31 percent higher at 119.59 points. The general IGPA index gained 0.18 percent to 5,364.21 points.
